title: Vue.js Small Examples
description: Use these small Vue.js examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Show a value in a template
examples.description: A Vue template describes the page. Double curly brackets show a JavaScript value as text.
examples.output: The page shows Garden club as its heading.

examples.title: Remember a changing value
examples.description: A ref is a small container for a value that Vue can watch.
examples.code:
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const count = ref(0);
</script>
<template><button @click="count++">Books: {{ count }}</button></template>
examples.output: Each click increases the displayed count by one.

examples.title: Bind an attribute
examples.description: v-bind connects an HTML attribute to a JavaScript value.
examples.output: The link points to the books heading using the bound value.

examples.title: Choose whether to show a part
examples.description: v-if includes a page part when its rule is true.
examples.output: The button switches between the two messages.

examples.title: Show a keyed list
examples.description: v-for makes one page part per list item.
examples.output: The page shows both book titles as list items.

examples.title: Connect an input with v-model
examples.description: v-model connects a form field to a value.
examples.output: The greeting follows the name typed into the field.

examples.title: Calculate a value from state
examples.description: A computed value is based on other reactive values.
examples.output: The page starts at 30 pages. Adding a book changes it to 40.

examples.title: Pass a prop to a child
examples.description: Props are values a parent gives a child component.
examples.output: The child card displays the title given by its parent.

examples.title: Send a child event
examples.description: A child can emit an event to ask its parent to do something.
examples.output: Clicking the child button makes the parent show Moon Trip.

examples.title: Leave a slot for content
examples.description: A slot leaves a place where a parent can supply page content.
examples.output: The supplied paragraph appears inside the note box after its heading.

examples.title: Clean up a timer
examples.description: A mounted hook can start work after a component joins the page.
examples.output: The number increases once per second while the component is mounted.

examples.title: Build a small reading list
examples.description: A form and a reactive array can work together.
examples.output: Submitting a non-empty title adds it to the list and clears the field. Reloading resets this in-memory list.
